caption: A hose sprays water onto a burning shed, and the flames shrink and the smoke turns from black to white steam.

sa.check: A hose sprays water onto it.
The flames shrink where the water lands.
The dark smoke gives way to white steam.
The steam rises from the wetted parts.
The spraying comes first and the shrinking follows.

pc.expect: The flames shrink where the water lands and the wetted parts stop burning.
pc.fail: The water lands and the flames burn on unchanged there; or the flames shrink on a part of the shed the water never reached; or the flames shrink before the water arrives; or the fire grows where the water lands.

pc.expect: The fire only shrinks while the water keeps coming and doused parts do not flare back up.
pc.fail: A doused part flares up again while the water still plays on it; or the flames shrink and grow in turn with the spray steady; or the charred wood turns back to unburnt timber; or the fire spreads to parts already soaked.

pc.expect: The smoke above the wetted parts changes from dark to white and stays white while the water plays there.
pc.fail: The white steam turns back to black smoke where the water still lands; or the smoke stays black over a part that is steaming wet; or the whole plume turns white before any water arrives; or the shed's paint changes colour rather than the smoke.

pc.expect: The water arcs from the hose down onto the shed while the smoke and steam rise.
pc.fail: The water arcs upward and keeps climbing out of view; or the plume sinks and pools around the shed; or the water runs up the shed's wall; or the plume hangs as a fixed shape without rising.

pc.expect: One shed and one stream; the shed's walls and roof stay in place as they char and the water comes only from the hose.
pc.fail: The shed vanishes at a stroke; or a second shed appears; or water appears on the shed with no stream reaching it; or the stream passes through a wall and out the far side unchanged.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ground around the shed, the hose and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The ground changes texture away from the water; or the background changes between frames; or the hose changes colour.

note: Who holds the hose is not judged.
